cause_quote: #194885 replaced the read-side checkpoint with `readLocalWorkspacePath(...)` and `readRoot = backing.root` under `if (params.worktreeId && params.root && !params.historical)` (no sandbox check), so reads came from the private checkout while saves still wrote only the canonical file after `checkpointLocalWorkspacePath`, never importing the saved bytes into that checkout.
user_saw: After saving a file in the Control UI, the next preview still showed the old contents, and host-only sessions with a leftover sandbox checkout previewed stale guest bytes.
summary: Saves now run the canonical CAS write and import the change into the private sandbox checkout under the same settled custody, private backing is used only for sandbox sessions, and the obsolete read-checkpoint adapter is removed.
reasoning: Before #194885, every read checkpointed guest changes and then read the canonical file, so a save followed by a read returned the saved bytes and host sessions read canonical files. #194885 (merged about 1.5 hours before this fix, which names it) switched reads to the live private checkout for any worktree session without synchronizing saves into that checkout; I read both diffs in session-file-read.ts and sessions-files.ts.
